name: 600 EX square-taper bottom bracket
weight_description: Weight not yet sourced for an identified BB-6207 square-taper spindle configuration. The 1986 double reference gives 326 g with 116/119 mm options, while the Biopace triple reference gives 330 g with 121.5/124.5 mm options. Neither identifies which spindle/shell configuration was weighed.
